messages:
toni: FYI were scheduling a short regional routing rehearsal this Sunday 01:30-02:15 UTC to exercise fallback tiers and rate-weight changes. Expect brief p99 blips when we shift traffic.

oncall-bot: Maintenance event created: id rr-2026-05-2350001234. Alerts will trigger 15m and 2m before start.

lee: Confirming Dedicated SLA routes excluded?

toni: Correct. Only hosted best-effort and internal staging. No private clusters touched.

infra-lead: Runbook summary: 1) T0: bump fallback weight in us-east-1 to 20% for 10m. 2) Monitor fallback-rate, kvcache hit, and p95 latency. 3) If error-rate >0.8% for 3m -> rollback.

pagerduty: Reminder scheduled: 2026-05-03T01:15:00Z  15 minutes until rr-2026-05-2350001234.

lee: I'll pre-warm prefixes 25m before. adding a short prewarm script to ops playbook.

toni: Oncall: lee primary, infra-lead secondary, toni as incident commander. Please post a status banner to #status-redwood 10m before start.

infra-lead: Added a smoke test: 40 requests across each affected route at T-5m, require >=99% success and p95 < 400ms.

toni: Thanks. Owners of pinned model routes, please ACK compatibility with fallback variants by EOD Sat or I'll DM. Keep updates here for live notes only.
